description: Defines classes and functions for bit encoding and decoding in byte buffers, including bit_encoder and bit_decoder classes, with custom formatters for printing.

classes.name: ocudu::bit_encoder
classes.description: Encodes bits into a byte buffer, providing methods to pack bits and bytes, and manage bit offsets.

classes.name: ocudu::bit_decoder
classes.description: Decodes bits from a byte buffer, providing methods to unpack bits and bytes, and manage read position.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Appends a bitmap of specified bits into the byte buffer, left aligned.

methods.name: pack_bytes
methods.description: Appends a range or a byte_buffer view of bytes into the byte buffer.

methods.name: align_bytes_zero
methods.description: Pads the buffer with zeros until the next byte boundary.

methods.name: advance_bits
methods.description: Advances the read position by a specified number of bits.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bits into a variable.

methods.name: unpack_bytes
methods.description: Reads unaligned bytes from the buffer.

methods.name: unpack_aligned_bytes
methods.description: Returns a view of a specified number of aligned bytes from the buffer.

methods.name: align_bytes
methods.description: Skips bits until the start of the next byte.
